buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Preferable manufacturer should participate. Participating traders/agents must provide authorization lett er issued by the OEM. Authorization letter should be tender/Bid specific. Bidders must submit valid authori zation letter containing the required information along with their offer failing which the offer is liable to be ignored. 2. For placement of order, the OEM [Principal Firm] directly or through authorized dealers shall have succe ssfully executed a contract for supply of Rubber Welding Hoses as per IS 447 to any Govt organization/PS U/PPP Project of minimum 10 percent of the advertised value of the bid [Bid Value – 29736.00] during prev ious 3 years. This period of 3 years shall be counted with respect to date of tender closing. In this regard, Firms should submit a past performance document in the form of CRN/CRAC/R-NOTE/completion certificate issued by competent authority of that Govt organization/PSU/PPP Project along with PO. Failure to submit d ocumentary evidence will imply that firm has no such performance and Railways reserves the right to disq ualify the offer. In case tenderer participates as an authorized agent, then the past performance as require d above shall be that of the principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has credentia ls of past supply for a different Principal, but these will not be considered as performance for placing the or der in case of change of Principal. 3. Contract shall be governed by IRS conditions. 4. Material Transportation, handling and unloading is in the scope of supplier. 5. Length of pipe should be in the multiple of 15 meters only. .
